silhouette.reason: Dark rounded outcrop with amber crystal clusters spiking out and a red claim flag: reads as a resource node at any distance. The rock itself is a smooth blob; the crystals stick out almost horizontally and look pinned on.
fixes: grow the crystal clusters out of fracture pockets in the rock (seat them 20-30% deep) and angle them upward

proportions.reason: 4.9 x 4.4 x 3.6 m: a crew-sized mining site beside 1.8 m workers. Crystals up to ~1.5 m are big but fit an RTS node.
fixes: shrink the side clusters ~20% so the top cluster leads the composition

materials.reason: Basalt reads dark, but the salt crust is blotchy white patches like camouflage, horizontal contour banding from the SDF UVs shows in the side views, and the crystals are flat amber plastic with no translucency, inner glow or facet sheen.
fixes: texture-space rock strip that survives SDF UVs (triplanar-like box projection) to remove the contour banding
crystal material with emissive core and lighter facet edges instead of flat amber

detail.reason: Four crystal clusters, a claim stake with finial, pennant and a flat red ground plate; the rock has no visible fracture planes, ledges or strata at hero distance.
fixes: sharp fracture facets and a couple of ledges on the outcrop (SDF subtract planes)
small loose crystal shards at the base

wear.reason: Salt dust on top faces and brine mud at the base exist but read as random patches; no mining scars, pick marks or spoil.
fixes: pick marks and a small spoil heap next to one cluster
salt dust concentrated in crevices rather than blotches

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the outcrop, all crystal clusters and the flag; salt patches become big flat facets.
fixes: lower-contrast salt at LOD2 so the facets do not flash

technical.reason: QA PASS (rebuilt today): 12.3k / 2.96k / 486 tris, 3 / 3 / 3 draws; deterministic, one trim material + team slot. Most LOD0 triangles go to the smooth SDF rock.
